title: Closure preparation snapshot
description: What one preparation produced, and the identity an integration approval names. Immutable once approved: the current file is a projection of the snapshot under .spectree/closure/<change>/<preparation_id>.json.

generation.description: Raised by every reopening. An approval names one, so an approval cannot survive a reopening by digest coincidence.

preparation_digest.description: Over identity, contract, candidate, base, archive location and the canonical artifact inventory. Timestamps and display text are excluded, so the same preparation run twice is the same preparation.

archive_path.description: Where the change folder went. Recorded because it is not recomputable: the slot name carries the date the preparation ran.

archive_absent_reason.description: Required when there is no archive_path. An absence nobody asserted is indistinguishable from a read that failed.

mode.description: The mode git records. An archived file is outside both the code and the contract digest, so a mode change with an identical blob had nothing else to catch it.

supersedes_approval.description: A PROJECTION of what a reopening retired. The durable record is the closure control; a document a restore can replace is not where authority lives.
